interpretation: GW_EXCHANGE_CUMULATIVE and GW_EXCHANGE_INTERVAL are distinct fidelity purposes even though both derive from the same exact interval water-balance identity.

For B01, added G12-to-G16 information improves long-horizon storage/exchange fidelity but leaves interval-scale storage-transition/flux error essentially unchanged in both Layer-ROM and matched Richards.
For B14, G12-to-G16 is a plateau for both temporal purposes.
Because the interval plateau occurs in matched conventional Richards on the same partitions, it cannot be attributed specifically to Layer-ROM propagation closure.

GW_EXCHANGE_CUMULATIVE.target: cumulative recharge/capillary exchange and long-horizon drift
GW_EXCHANGE_CUMULATIVE.information_need: accurate storage level evolution over the evaluation horizon
GW_EXCHANGE_CUMULATIVE.p4_p7_status: state-count/material dependent; B01 still benefits from G12-to-G16, B14 does not

GW_EXCHANGE_INTERVAL.target: interval-average exchange flux, sign/reversal and event-scale response
GW_EXCHANGE_INTERVAL.information_need: accurate storage increments at the reporting interval
GW_EXCHANGE_INTERVAL.p4_p7_status: G12-to-G16 plateau in both tested methods/materials; additional count in the tested placement family does not add useful interval-transition information

next_scientific_question: Which physically interpretable transition-memory carrier, rather than additional cells in the tested G-family, distinguishes next-interval total-storage change under lower-head forcing?
